scenario: [LFAC.9.1]: a marker on `ts` is refused on ANY base lifecycle with DS_VALIDATE_TS_MARKED, not only on `logical`. A `ttl` schema marks `ts: Time key`; a marker on any other slot of it would be DS_VALIDATE_IDENTITY_ROLE_NON_LOGICAL ([LGRA.5.10], `LGRA.5.10.non_logical`), and the `ts` check runs ahead of that one, so the code is 1825. PATH: `dsc.validate.lgra_5_10_slot`, whose `ts` arm precedes the non-logical arm.
